findings.summary: SPA bouncer redirects /admin/kitchen-display-system away after ~1-3 seconds — direct nav lands on /admin/dashboard, /admin/pos-v4, /admin/cash-overview, /kiosk/idle, or /login non-deterministically. Sidebar click on the KDS link (href=/admin/kitchen-display-system) also redirects to /admin/pos-v4 or /admin/cash-overview. Blocks E2E test infrastructure (Playwright) from reliably reaching the KDS surface and exercising the bump → recall flow.

findings.impact: Owner reports + Playwright E2E CI cannot reliably reach the kitchen display surface for visual proof. Operationally a chef typing the URL into the address bar would experience the same flap. Workaround: use a Vue-Router pushState approach immediately after navigation but before the bouncer fires.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Likely an interaction between Vue Router's beforeEach guard + a kiosk-default redirect path that's been re-installed in the SPA app entry. Same agent SYS-3-KDS observed similar bounce on 2026-05-28 morning (per /reports/test-e2e/per-system-2026-05-28/agents/SYS-3-KDS.json verdict 'BLOCKED SPA-routing defect'). NOT root-caused this session — log shows /api/admin/pos/cash-drawer/sessions/current returning 401 just before bounces which may trigger an interceptor.
findings.recommended_fix: Add Vue Router meta.requiresKds on the KDS route + an explicit guard that returns true if user.permissions includes 'kitchen-display-system'. Remove any kiosk-app-default-route hook that may be re-installed during admin nav.

findings.summary: Silent HTML masquerade on /api/api/admin/kds-order/ — sending an extra /api prefix to fetch (or any unmatched /api/* path) returns 200 with text/html SPA index instead of 404 JSON. Easy to trip in frontend axios mis-configuration when developers don't subtract baseURL.
evidence_paths: browser_evaluate result: GET /api/admin/kds-order/ via window.axios (baseURL=/api → /api/api/admin/kds-order/) returned status 200, content-type 'text/html; charset=UTF-8', dataSample starting '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="fr">' — confirms Laravel SPA catchall masquerade for unmatched /api/* paths
reproducer: 3. Response: 200 with HTML (DOCTYPE html instead of JSON envelope)
findings.impact: Silent client-side bugs: developer expects {data:[]} structure, gets HTML string, silently treats as empty list. Hides routing typos in PR review. Already documented in MEMORY/reference (feedback_silent_html_masquerade.md).
findings.recommended_fix: Tighten the SPA catchall route at /routes/web.php to exclude /api/* (route group exclude) OR add a middleware that returns 404 JSON for unmatched /api/* requests.
